intro:
Rotate the shot into place!
A neon night photo puzzle
Restore the whole picture
description:
Can you piece the night back together, one twist at a time?

Set beside a glamorous pool after dark, this is a photo puzzle about restoring a broken-up picture.

How to play is simple!
・Look carefully at the direction of the photo
・Rotate each slice into the right orientation
・Follow the flow of the image to complete one picture

The controls are intuitive, so even puzzle newcomers can jump in quickly.
As the stages progress, it gets harder to judge from a single part of the photo. Background details, hair, outfits and lights all become clues that test your powers of observation.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy photo puzzles and rotation puzzles
・Want a puzzle they can play in short sessions
・Like focusing on a solo challenge
・Enjoy bright night views and resort-style scenes
・Like games that use observation and quick thinking

Take in the neon-lit night scene and aim to restore every photo!

Playable with button controls or touch controls.
